Mind-controlled slave |TV actor =[[Sarah Waisman]] }} '''Rita''' is a character who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== According to [[Hank MacLean]], Rita was formerly a slave of [[Caesar's Legion]], where she would "cook people" for the Legion. She was later captured by Hank and/or his mind-controlled "workers," and turned into one of the workers herself using a [[brain-computer interface chip]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Other Player]]=== Rita, under mind control and dressed as an [[X-Branch office worker|office worker]], is seen working in the [[Las Vegas management Vault]] for Hank as part of the production line for more brain control chips. When [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] later comes to bring Hank to justice, Hank uses Rita as one of his examples to convince Lucy that his technology would benefit humanity. He notes that Rita makes an "excellent" trail mix, which is seen on her desk. Rita offers the trail mix to Lucy, but she refuses. ==Appearances== Rita appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|14=206}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Caesar's Legion characters]]
